locator: Table 1 / High-stakes sabotage opportunities / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
context_stem: Row: High-stakes sabotage opportunities; Column: Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
excerpt: A frontier developer should make a strong argument that AI systems will not carry out sabotage leading to irreversibly and substantially higher odds of a later global catastrophe.
paraphrase: Developers should argue AI systems will not cause sabotage that substantially raises odds of later global catastrophe.

locator: Table 1 / High-stakes sabotage opportunities / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
context_stem: Row: High-stakes sabotage opportunities; Column: Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
excerpt: This case may initially be relatively simple and rely heavily on capability limitations, if it is first required when the risk is merely plausible.
paraphrase: The safety case may initially rely on capability limitations if required only when risk is merely plausible.

locator: Table 1 / High-stakes sabotage opportunities / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
context_stem: Row: High-stakes sabotage opportunities; Column: Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations
excerpt: As risk becomes harder to rule out, this case will likely include some combination of:
paraphrase: As risk becomes harder to exclude, the safety case will likely combine several measures.

locator: Table 1 / High-stakes sabotage opportunities / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations / bullet 1
context_stem: As risk becomes harder to rule out, this case will likely include some combination of:
excerpt: Internal compartmentalization, restriction, and code review to prevent excessive sabotage opportunities for AI models.
paraphrase: Measure: internal compartmentalization, restriction, and code review to limit sabotage opportunities.

locator: Table 1 / High-stakes sabotage opportunities / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations / bullet 2
context_stem: As risk becomes harder to rule out, this case will likely include some combination of:
excerpt: Capability assessments demonstrating that AI models lack the ability to carry out irreversible (which would generally mean unnoticed) sabotage.
paraphrase: Measure: capability assessments showing models lack ability for irreversible/unnoticed sabotage.

locator: Table 1 / High-stakes sabotage opportunities / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations / bullet 3
context_stem: As risk becomes harder to rule out, this case will likely include some combination of:
excerpt: Monitoring and/or restricting AI behavior and usage internally.
paraphrase: Measure: internal monitoring and/or restriction of AI behavior and usage.

locator: Table 1 / High-stakes sabotage opportunities / Mitigations—ambitious industry-wide recommendations / bullet 4
context_stem: As risk becomes harder to rule out, this case will likely include some combination of:
excerpt: Evidence that AI models lack the propensity to deceive, manipulate, or sabotage users.
paraphrase: Measure: evidence demonstrating models lack the propensity to deceive, manipulate, or sabotage users.

locator: Table 1 / Automated R&D in key domains / Capability or usage threshold
context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains; Column: Capability or usage threshold
excerpt: AI systems that can fully automate, or otherwise dramatically accelerate, the work of large, top-tier teams of human researchers in domains where fast progress could cause threats to international security and/or rapid disruptions to the global balance of power—for example, energy, robotics, weapons development and AI itself.
paraphrase: The threshold covers AI able to fully automate or dramatically accelerate top-tier research teams in domains where fast progress threatens international security or the global balance of power.

locator: Table 1 / Automated R&D in key domains / Capability or usage threshold
context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains; Column: Capability or usage threshold
excerpt: For now, our evaluations will focus specifically on AI R&D, as this domain likely plays to AI systems' current strengths and is more tractable to assess than capabilities in other domains.
paraphrase: Evaluations currently focus on AI R&D since it fits AI systems' current strengths and is easier to assess.

locator: Table 1 / Automated R&D in key domains / Capability or usage threshold
context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains; Column: Capability or usage threshold
excerpt: Additionally, AI R&D alone could cause acceleration in AI capabilities improvements, to the point where all of the threats listed above (and more) develop very quickly.
paraphrase: AI R&D acceleration alone could speed up development of all other listed threats.

locator: Table 1 / Automated R&D in key domains / Capability or usage threshold
context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains; Column: Capability or usage threshold
excerpt: We will consider this threshold to be met if we determine that either (1) our models would be able to fully substitute for our entire set of Research Scientists and Research Engineers, at competitive costs (i.e., within a factor of 5); or (2) there is "dramatic acceleration" of the pace of AI progress for reasons that likely relate to the automation of AI R&D.
paraphrase: The threshold is met if models can fully substitute for the entire Research Scientist/Engineer workforce within 5x cost, or if AI R&D automation causes dramatic acceleration of AI progress.

locator: Table 1 / Automated R&D in key domains / Capability or usage threshold
context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains; Column: Capability or usage threshold
excerpt: We would consider scenario (2) to have occurred where (a) we observe or expect double the rate of progress in AI aggregate capabilities compared to the rate we'd expect in the absence of significant AI contributions to AI R&D and (b) it is plausible that this doubling is substantially attributable to the automation of research and/or engineering (as opposed to other factors, such as increased headcount, compute, or general productivity), such that continuation of the trend in AI progress could lead to even greater acceleration.
paraphrase: Scenario 2 is defined as observing/expecting a doubling of AI progress rate plausibly due to automation of research/engineering rather than other factors, potentially leading to further acceleration.

locator: Table 1 / Automated R&D in key domains / Capability or usage threshold
context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains; Column: Capability or usage threshold
excerpt: This capability threshold is intended to reflect our definition of highly capable models (see Section 3.6).
paraphrase: This threshold reflects the framework's definition of highly capable models.

locator: Table 1 / Automated R&D in key domains / Capability or usage threshold
context_stem: Row: Automated R&D in key domains; Column: Capability or usage threshold
excerpt: It may be sensible to add earlier, and/or easier-to-measure, thresholds that trigger less demanding versions of the mitigations for this threshold.
paraphrase: Additional earlier or more measurable thresholds triggering lighter mitigations might be added.
